bindingAndCompatibility.DSA: Use glNamedBufferData only when (GLAD_GL_VERSION_4_5 OR GLAD_GL_ARB_direct_state_access) AND glNamedBufferData!=nullptr. No binding/query operations on this branch.
bindingAndCompatibility.HEADLESS: Compile out all new GL capability tests and orphan GL calls under #ifndef HEADLESS; only reset the marker. No new gladstub symbols or behavior required.
bindingAndCompatibility.VAO: Both paths leave the current VAO, its EBO association, ARRAY_BUFFER, indexed SSBO bindings and unrelated COPY_WRITE binding unchanged.
bindingAndCompatibility.fallback: Only when core3.1 or GLAD_GL_ARB_copy_buffer is supported: save GL_COPY_WRITE_BUFFER_BINDING, bind the same id to GL_COPY_WRITE_BUFFER, replace storage, and restore the exact previous binding. Never touch ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER.
bindingAndCompatibility.fallbackCost: One state query and two binds on a real invalidation; possible driver/thread overhead remains unmeasured.
bindingAndCompatibility.fallbackEvidence: GlobalRendering.cpp:56-57 allows GL3.0; VBO.cpp checks GLAD_GL_ARB_copy_buffer separately.
bindingAndCompatibility.unsupported: If neither guarded DSA nor COPY_WRITE is supported, skip the optimization with no GL call; preserve existing bytes and clear the frame upload marker. Generic engine configuration permits GL3.0.
bindingAndCompatibility.whyBothChecks: The local core4.5 loader has its version guard commented out. A non-null loaded pointer alone is not sufficient evidence of API support.

callerContracts.contract: Readonly returns before Swap, Invalidate and Clear. For other Typed buffers, Swap each existing stream, explicitly Invalidate it, then retain the original CPU Clear and upload/start-index reset.
IStreamBuffer gets a default no-op Invalidate. Only BufferSubDataImpl overrides it. Ordinary stream Swap remains unchanged, including persistent/ring/fence behavior.

Sparse/idle model data and indexed SSBO bindings continue to retain their bytes. The uploader calls ordinary Swap, never the new Invalidate. Its BufferSubData fallback also retains content across frames.
RenderBuffer::SwapRenderBuffers precedes existing PutBufferLocks and native presentation. No draw-frame boundary, fence ordering or GPU-completion requirement changes.

CopyCurrent creates independent CPU vectors and later independent streams/VAO. Readonly copies survive source frame resets; non-readonly copies retain their own frame-local behavior. Existing index-bias arithmetic and move ownership are unchanged.

GetPendingElemsRange/DrawElementsRange remain valid until the next SwapBuffer. Projectile reuse requires matching drawFrame. Chobby lacks this API; do not add it or pretend to test its presence there.
Font primary/outline streams explicitly select BufferSubData; the Typed default also selects it. This establishes static reach, not current workload frequency or benefit.

externalPrecedent.adaptation: Keep the explicit Invalidate API and Typed-only caller; replace target Bind/Unbind with guarded DSA or binding-preserving COPY_WRITE fallback. Reset the upload marker on new storage and ignore zero-byte upload calls without losing a prior positive marker.
externalPrecedent.author: Leon Seemann
externalPrecedent.originalScope: 22 additions and 2 deletions in RenderBuffers.h and StreamBuffer.h
externalPrecedent.performanceEvidence: External KK lobby observations motivate the experiment; no conversion into expected BAR/MVK FPS or pass reduction.

implementationGate: Root completes R/Small comparison, selects the parent, and issues a separate source/build grant. No parent is selected here.

laterBuildAndPackaging.MVKTrap: The active raw MoltenVK currently contains Small. Never copy it into this engine-only candidate. Preserve the chosen parent's packaged MVK by exact hash and inventory, even when the chosen parent is R.
laterBuildAndPackaging.apply: Verify selected-parent source and proposal preimages first. Apply textual hunks as new edits with current mtime; never restore historical header mtimes using copy2. Preserve file modes. The added virtual method changes internal vtable layout, so all dependent native translation units must rebuild consistently.
laterBuildAndPackaging.package: Clone the selected parent into a new private candidate; replace and sign only the two corresponding engine executables, then sign the outer app. Expected additional differences are outer signature records only.
laterBuildAndPackaging.parent: Root will choose the exact R or accepted Small frozen app after comparison. Unresolved now.
laterBuildAndPackaging.qualification: Verify both unchanged official version identities, loader closure, unchanged launcher code/ASAR, runtime libraries, presentation assets and parent inventory. No installation or publication; root owns later app/game/performance acceptance.
laterBuildAndPackaging.target: Existing engine-legacy/spring target, incremental only; preserve CMake configuration and verify dependent compilation in the build log. No clean build, competing lane or whole-stack refresh.

risksAndStopConditions: A frame-local candidate can reduce implicit synchronization or staging, but orphaning can increase retained in-flight backing and driver allocation work.
Extra virtual calls on Typed Swap and upload-marker writes are small new CPU work, not assumed free.
Binding mutation, readonly/model content loss, same-frame range failure, unsupported entrypoint calls or excessive memory churn require correction or withdrawal before adoption.
This does not repair unrelated pre-existing CPU-buffer/Resize/CopyCurrent behavior or alter its arithmetic. Report any newly observed issue separately instead of broadening silently.

scopeAndPreservation.AI: Codex-assisted local design and proposed code. No upstream PR/issue/comment is submitted. Future external contribution must follow the lane AI_POLICY disclosure, accepted-issue and human-verification requirements.
scopeAndPreservation.nativePolicy: Keep official engine identities, SYNCCHECK, numeric/compiler policy, NoGS and immutable healthbar/tracker sources byte-identical. No synced code, game content, Lua syntax or visual assets change.
scopeAndPreservation.proposedProductFiles: Only RenderBuffers.h and StreamBuffer.h in each of the two native lanes, 4 paths total.
scopeAndPreservation.sourcePins: unapplied-source-proposal.json records exact preimages, proposed images, the two CMake caches, inspected callers/fixtures, and current immutable presentation-provider source bytes.
scopeAndPreservation.stack: No Mesa/Loader/SDL/MoltenVK source or binary replacement. MVK #2837 is a separate third unit.

storageState.gpuLifetime: The GL storage-replacement contract preserves already-issued commands. The driver may rename, retain old storage or synchronize internally; this proposal does not prescribe its allocator or claim lower peak memory.
storageState.initial: uploaded=false; no allocation or query added by fresh/no-upload Invalidate
storageState.invalidate: Only when marked, use a supported storage-replacement branch on the same id/byteSize/usage; otherwise leave storage intact. Clear the marker after the frame-boundary attempt. Repeated calls do no GL work.
storageState.move: Typed move transfers unique stream ownership; the upload marker travels with that stream object. Do not reset it on Typed move.
storageState.resize: The existing Init/CreateBuffer replaces storage and resets uploaded=false. CPU client pointer, own-buffer allocation, partial-upload rules and existing Resize behavior remain unchanged.
storageState.upload: After the existing Unmap/BufferSubData call, OR the marker with mapElemCount>0. A zero-byte call does not erase an earlier upload marker.
